message: 生徒会長は君

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks as always, pops!」
All right, I've returned last month's milk bottles too. Now then, time to scurry on off to school--

name: Man
message: 「Good day, my lady. Might you spend a sweet yet poignant supreme moment with me?」

name: Girl
message: 「Eh, eh!?」

name: Man
message: 「To captivate me at first glance-what a sinful person you must be. To atone for that sin, you must join me at that cafe right over there--」

name: Girl
message: 「Hyauah!! Th-That's, I can't do that!」

name: Man
message: 「Sexy & Beauty. In that case, how about clinking wine glasses with me over high-end French cuisine?」

name: Girl
message: 「Uh-uh-uh, um... I'm sorry!!」
Ooh, so that's the rumored 'hitting on girls' I've heard about.
Even though he hits on various girls and gets rejected right away, he doesn't let it get him down and immediately makes a move on the next girl.
He's sure got guts. There's no way I could ever imitate that. When it comes to French food, French fries are the best I can do.
I end up locking eyes with that handsome guy.
He strides briskly right up to me and declares,

name: Man
message: 「How would you like to grab some tea with me?」
Does this mean he's finally running out of pickup lines?

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, hold on!!」
Why am I the one getting hit on!?

name: Man
message: 「It seems you are quite flustered by our overly shocking encounter. However, I have no intention of leaving your side for even a moment.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Stop it, please」

name: Man
message: 「There is nothing to fear. Gently caring for you as one would dote on a fledgling is a gentleman's duty」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, why are you hitting on me?!」

name: Man
message: 「Heh... If that rough masculine pronoun is part of your identity, then I shall simply follow suit.」

name: Synn
message: 「I have no idea what you're talking about!」

name: Man
message: 「Oui, mademoiselle. At any rate, let us rest your body. Somewhere calm and quiet...」
He wraps his arm around my waist. For some reason, it also felt like he was touching my butt.
If I remember right, 'mademoiselle' means a young lady, doesn't it.

name: Man
message: 「Of course, even if you told me to stay until morning, I wouldn't have any objections.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, I'm... actually a guy.」
His body swiftly pulls away. The whole thing takes roughly 0.6 seconds.

name: Man
message: 「My apologies. It seems I was drawn in by your extraordinary charm.」

name: Synn
message: 「No... well, as long as you understand, it's fine.」
Anyway, I don't want to get any more involved with him. Let's get out of here quickly.

name: Synn
message: 「W-What is it?」

name: Man
message: 「I deeply apologize for my rude behavior.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh...」

name: Melphas
message: 「My name is Melphas. Please remember me going forward.」
Even if you introduce yourself to me, I don't really know what to do with that...

name: Melphas
message: 「If you don't mind, may I ask your name?」

name: Synn
message: 「Me? I'm Synn Sakura.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Synn... Sakura... Ah, you're the Student Council President at Ryuusei Academy.」

name: Synn
message: 「You know about me?」

name: Melphas
message: 「When it comes to the organizer of the Ryuusei Academy Sparkling Festival, you're quite the celebrity in this town.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so...」

name: Melphas
message: 「In addition to that--」

name: Melphas
message: 「No, it's nothing. It's just that I recall hearing that name before.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it's not really that unusual of a name.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Now then. I shall once again wander off in search of new encounters and excitement.」

name: Synn
message: 「Please keep it in moderation...」

name: Melphas
message: 「Well then, good day to you, Student Council President.」
Saying that, Melphas went right back to hitting on girls.
He's a weird guy, though he doesn't seem all that bad. Polite, too.
Well, time to pull myself together and head to school.
